rumours: Travellers in Alinor whisper that old toll-charters across Summerset Isle are being bought up by secretive factors.
Watchmen along the Summerset Isle trails say lanterns have been seen moving inside the ancient vaults after midnight.
Stewards serving High Kinlord Rilis-Auri posted fresh commissions at Alinor for anyone who can secure the outlying ruins of Summerset Isle.
Wayfarers resting in Summerset Isle swear the roadside shrines hum softly whenever a storm rolls across the border.
Clerks in Alinor complain that sealed crates bypass the customs posts of the High Kinship of Alinor without inspection.
Local folk in Summerset Isle still leave an offering on the boundary stones to keep the older spirits quiet.
A chronicler arrived in Alinor last week asking after First and Second Era garrison rolls for Summerset Isle.
Apothecaries in Alinor pay good silver for rare moss and resin gathered from the ruins of Summerset Isle.
Veterans in Alinor still debate which company held the frontier pass of Summerset Isle during the Crisis.
Smugglers working the back-tracks of Summerset Isle use chipped milestones to mark their midnight drop-sites.
legends: In the First Era, when the earliest boundary stones were raised across Summerset Isle, the watchtowers of the High Kinship of Alinor echoed with bronze horns for seven nights.
Old ballads of Alinor tell of a standard-bearer who sealed his company's charter chest beneath a stronghold in Summerset Isle and swore never to yield the key.
Folk in Summerset Isle speak of the Twilight Surveyor, a phantom chronicler who walks the milestones toward Alinor during Frostfall, measuring whether the old pacts still hold.
Beneath the oldest foundations of Alinor, builders claim an unbroken subterranean conduit still links the shrines of Summerset Isle.
During the Second Era interregnum, an envoy of the High Kinship of Alinor walked alone into the deepest ruin of Summerset Isle and returned with the truce-ring that still hangs in Alinor.
Every century when the moons align over Summerset Isle, the sunken bells near Alinor are said to chime three times beneath the earth.
Carvers in Alinor preserve the tale of the First Warden of Summerset Isle, who traded his shadow to seal the lower fault-gates against intruders.
According to the temple rolls of Alinor, the oldest road through Summerset Isle follows the footprints of the ancestors who first named the land.

songs.title: The High Road to Alinor
lines: O the road to Alinor winds ancient and long,
Where the wardens of Summerset Isle still march with a song;
Keep your lantern trimmed bright through the mist and the rain,
Till the gates of Alinor rise before us again.

songs.title: Watchfires of Summerset Isle
lines: Raise a cup for Summerset Isle, where the old beacons gleam,
Above ruin and valley, by causeway and stream;
Though the borderlands shift and the smugglers may scheme,
Still the folk of Alinor keep the ancestors' dream.

songs.title: Boundary Stones of Alinor
lines: From the pass to the harbour the mile-pillars stand,
Cut by chisels of old across Summerset Isle's proud land;
Count the leagues into Alinor with steel in your hand,
For the spirits of Summerset Isle bow to no stranger's command.

songs.title: Lamplight in Alinor
lines: When the dusk settles deep over Summerset Isle's wide shore,
And the barges tie fast by the customhouse door;
May the wards of Alinor hold the night-wind at bay,
Till the horns of the morningwatch welcome the day.

aeriisen_sanctum.hook: Aeriisen Sanctum (dungeon fixed) stands at (-12969, 14375) in Summerset Isle, where the weathered masonry still bears the marks of Alinor's frontier history.
aeriisen_sanctum.rumour: Folks in Alinor say anyone who searches Aeriisen Sanctum in Summerset Isle will find traces of the old wardens and recent smugglers' caches.
aeriisen_sanctum.quest: Investigate the reports surrounding Aeriisen Sanctum in Summerset Isle and report to the wardens at Alinor.

notes.title: Surveyor's Field-Log at Aeriisen Sanctum
notes.author: Geographical Chroniclers' Guild
pages: On the fourteenth day of our circuit through Summerset Isle, we set our transit-rod at Aeriisen Sanctum (survey grid -12969, 14375 under the High Kinship of Alinor). The foundations here show three distinct strata of occupation, and our local guide from Alinor refused to camp within forty paces of the threshold after sundown.

notes.title: Warden's Dispatch: Aeriisen Sanctum
notes.author: Chancery of Alinor
pages: To the watch-corporal posted at Aeriisen Sanctum (-12969, 14375): by warrant of High Kinlord Rilis-Auri in Alinor, patrols along this sector of Summerset Isle are to inspect all night-convoys bearing unsealed casks and report any broken boundary stones to the High Kinship of Alinor.

notes.title: Factor's Private Missive from Aeriisen Sanctum
notes.author: Factor-Clerk Vorian
pages: My dear colleague in Alinor: the inventory cached at Aeriisen Sanctum (grid -12969, 14375 in Summerset Isle) remains untouched by the bailiffs of the High Kinship of Alinor. So long as the border watches stay occupied, our drovers can move two dozen crates a week past Aeriisen Sanctum without paying toll.

notes.title: Antiquarian Notes on Aeriisen Sanctum
notes.author: Chronicler Mirabelle of the Archives
pages: Among the secondary sites of Summerset Isle, Aeriisen Sanctum (situated at coordinates -12969, 14375 within the jurisdiction of the High Kinship of Alinor) merits closer study. The stonework preserves tool-marks characteristic of early regional craft oriented toward Alinor.

notes.title: Wayfarer's Warning at Aeriisen Sanctum
notes.author: Road-Warden of Alinor
pages: Travellers bound for Alinor across Summerset Isle: do not unhitch your teams at Aeriisen Sanctum (-12969, 14375) after the evening mist rises. Outriders of the High Kinship of Alinor reported hostile movement inside the perimeter of Aeriisen Sanctum last fortnight.

notes.title: Rubbing from the Boundary Stone at Aeriisen Sanctum
notes.author: Wayshrine Chronicler
pages: Transcribed from the weathered lintel at Aeriisen Sanctum (-12969, 14375 in Summerset Isle): 'Here stands the watch-stone of the High Kinship of Alinor, raised to guard the approach to Alinor. Let whoever takes shelter within these walls keep the lamp lit and the threshold clean.'

notes.title: Tithe and Toll Roll of Aeriisen Sanctum
notes.author: Assize Bailiff of Alinor
pages: Extracted from the regional assessment book for Aeriisen Sanctum (grid -12969, 14375 in Summerset Isle): twelve loads of dressed stone, four casks of lamp-oil, and eighteen silver pieces remitted to the High Kinship of Alinor at Alinor.

notes.title: Scout's Night-Watch Report: Aeriisen Sanctum
notes.author: Outrider of the High Kinship of Alinor
pages: Submitted to the guard-captain at Alinor: at midnight we observed lantern-signals flashing from the upper masonry of Aeriisen Sanctum (-12969, 14375 in Summerset Isle). Fresh tracks lead from the threshold toward the main road.

wreck_of_the_silver_anchor.rumour: Folks in Artaeum say anyone who searches Wreck of the Silver Anchor in Artaeum will find traces of the old wardens and recent smugglers' caches.
wreck_of_the_silver_anchor.quest: Investigate the reports surrounding Wreck of the Silver Anchor in Artaeum and report to the wardens at Artaeum.

notes.title: Surveyor's Field-Log at Wreck of the Silver Anchor
notes.author: Geographical Chroniclers' Guild
pages: On the fourteenth day of our circuit through Artaeum, we set our transit-rod at Wreck of the Silver Anchor (survey grid -12042, 11127 under the Psijic Conclave of Artaeum). The foundations here show three distinct strata of occupation, and our local guide from Artaeum refused to camp within forty paces of the threshold after sundown.

notes.title: Warden's Dispatch: Wreck of the Silver Anchor
notes.author: Chancery of Artaeum
pages: To the watch-corporal posted at Wreck of the Silver Anchor (-12042, 11127): by warrant of Ritemaster Iachesis-Cel in Artaeum, patrols along this sector of Artaeum are to inspect all night-convoys bearing unsealed casks and report any broken boundary stones to the Psijic Conclave of Artaeum.

notes.title: Factor's Private Missive from Wreck of the Silver Anchor
notes.author: Factor-Clerk Vorian
pages: My dear colleague in Artaeum: the inventory cached at Wreck of the Silver Anchor (grid -12042, 11127 in Artaeum) remains untouched by the bailiffs of the Psijic Conclave of Artaeum. So long as the border watches stay occupied, our drovers can move two dozen crates a week past Wreck of the Silver Anchor without paying toll.

notes.title: Antiquarian Notes on Wreck of the Silver Anchor
notes.author: Chronicler Mirabelle of the Archives
pages: Among the secondary sites of Artaeum, Wreck of the Silver Anchor (situated at coordinates -12042, 11127 within the jurisdiction of the Psijic Conclave of Artaeum) merits closer study. The stonework preserves tool-marks characteristic of early regional craft oriented toward Artaeum.

notes.title: Wayfarer's Warning at Wreck of the Silver Anchor
notes.author: Road-Warden of Artaeum
pages: Travellers bound for Artaeum across Artaeum: do not unhitch your teams at Wreck of the Silver Anchor (-12042, 11127) after the evening mist rises. Outriders of the Psijic Conclave of Artaeum reported hostile movement inside the perimeter of Wreck of the Silver Anchor last fortnight.

notes.title: Rubbing from the Boundary Stone at Wreck of the Silver Anchor
notes.author: Wayshrine Chronicler
pages: Transcribed from the weathered lintel at Wreck of the Silver Anchor (-12042, 11127 in Artaeum): 'Here stands the watch-stone of the Psijic Conclave of Artaeum, raised to guard the approach to Artaeum. Let whoever takes shelter within these walls keep the lamp lit and the threshold clean.'

notes.title: Tithe and Toll Roll of Wreck of the Silver Anchor
notes.author: Assize Bailiff of Artaeum
pages: Extracted from the regional assessment book for Wreck of the Silver Anchor (grid -12042, 11127 in Artaeum): twelve loads of dressed stone, four casks of lamp-oil, and eighteen silver pieces remitted to the Psijic Conclave of Artaeum at Artaeum.
